summary: Iteration 45 — RETEST of the CRITICAL Gold Master honesty defect from iteration_44. FIX VERIFIED. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration45_goldmaster_honesty.py in ~2s. (1) POST /api/factory-os/projects/{pid}/approve on a project with current gate=gold_master (asset-linked 0fd82cc8-9d2c-43b7-9bc5-13a26e87560e) now returns 200 with requires_certification=true, a note containing 'Gold Master Certified™ cannot be granted by simple approval. Certify it (Technical + Brand QA must be 100) from the Gold Master certification action.', and the gold_master stage stays 'needs_approval' (verified via GET refresh). (2) Non-gold-master gate regression: took an existing project at video_script:in_progress (f5545157-…), walked it through complete-stage 3× to reach founder_approval:needs_approval, called /approve — returned 200 with NO requires_certification, founder_approval flipped to complete, auto-continuation landed on gold_master:needs_approval. Calling /approve a 2nd time on that same project (now at gold_master) correctly REFUSED (requires_certification=true, gold_master stayed needs_approval). (3) Real cert path: POST /api/media-library/showcase/{asset_id}/certify-gold-master on the asset linked to 0fd82cc8 returned 400 with a QA/certification message; gold_master stage on the project stayed needs_approval. (4) DB scan of all 13 continuity projects: 2 projects have gold_master=complete (1355312e, 5e4bd6e8) and both have gold_master evidence in history (action contains 'gold_master') — 0 offenders. Frontend Playwright (1920x1080, Founder login → /projects): rendered 5 [data-testid=project-certify-gm-{id}] buttons ('Certify Gold Master™', visible) — 0fd82cc8, 1e519b77, 010d4afc, 784bd0d7, f5545157 — and 0 [data-testid=project-approve-{id}] buttons. Founder Freedom Ledger banner still renders (0.7h absorbed, 8 automated actions, 2 auto-published). No regression on any other UI.
action_items: OPTIONAL — Add a persistent 'certify_only:true' flag on CHAINS gate stages that require certification (§10). This would generalize the guard beyond gold_master and prevent regression if a new certification-only gate is added in the future.
OPTIONAL — Log the 'except Exception: pass' in /app/backend/routers/media_library.py::certify_gold_master (line 205) so that on_gold_master failures remain observable. Currently silent.
critical_code_review_comments: continuity.py::approve_gate (fix verified) — the `if cur['id'] == 'gold_master': return {**p, 'summary': ..., 'requires_certification': True, 'note': ...}` guard is honest and correct. Consider raising HTTP 409/400 at the router instead of returning 200 with requires_certification, so external API consumers detect the refusal via status code — though the current 200+flag is what the frontend expects and works.

ProjectsContinuity.js (fix verified) — the conditional rendering `cur?.id === 'gold_master' → project-certify-gm-{id}` vs `cur?.id !== 'gold_master' → project-approve-{id}` is clean and correctly disables the wrong button.
media_library.py::certify_gold_master — still swallows on_gold_master exceptions with a bare `except Exception: pass` (line 205). Not exploited by current bug but a hidden failure surface.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 certify-gm buttons, 0/0 approve buttons on gold_master gates)

rca of the issue: iteration_44 root cause was continuity.approve_gate unconditionally completing any needs_approval gate (including gold_master), bypassing Constitution §10 Technical+Brand QA=100 certification. Fix in continuity.py:246-250 adds a stage-id branch: `if cur['id'] == 'gold_master': return {..., requires_certification: True, note: 'Gold Master Certified™ cannot be granted by simple approval...'}` — the gate stays needs_approval and no history entry is added. The only path that completes gold_master is now on_gold_master, invoked only from POST /api/media-library/showcase/{asset_id}/certify-gold-master (after flagship_showcase.certify_gold_master enforces QA gates). Frontend fix in ProjectsContinuity.js:119-124 branches the button: for gold_master gate it renders project-certify-gm-{id} calling the certify endpoint; for other gates it renders project-approve-{id} calling /approve. All 4 legacy false-cert projects (0fd82cc8, 1e519b77, 010d4afc, 784bd0d7) were remediated back to gold_master:needs_approval. Verified via curl + pytest + playwright. Reproduction is now negative: /approve on gold_master gate returns requires_certification and stage stays needs_approval; on founder_approval gate it still completes and auto-advances (regression preserved).
